home.title: Every answer is quoted from an official admissions document.
home.description: Ask about admission methods, quotas, fees, paperwork or deadlines. If the uploaded documents do not cover your question, the assistant says so plainly — it does not guess.
home.forbiddenDescription: You can still ask admissions questions below.

chat.emptyLibraryDescription: The assistant cannot answer anything until a teacher uploads one. Please check back later.
chat.suggestion2: Which programmes does the university offer?

history.title: Question history
history.emptyDescription: Questions you ask while signed in are saved here.
history.renameDescription: This name appears only in your history.
history.deleteDescription: {count, plural, one {The conversation and its # message will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.} other {The conversation and all # messages in it will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.}}

documents.title: Admissions documents
documents.uploadHint: PDF only, up to {size} MB each and {max} files at a time. Indexing runs in the background, one file at a time — you can leave this page or close the browser.
documents.emptyDescription: Upload an admissions announcement as a PDF. Once indexed, the assistant answers students from that text.
documents.deleteDescription: “{title}” will be removed from the list and from the assistant's index. Students will no longer get answers quoted from it.
documents.reupload: Upload the same file again to retry indexing.
documents.uploadedTitle: {count, plural, one {# file accepted} other {# files accepted}}
documents.uploadedDescription: {count, plural, one {# file is waiting to be indexed. You can leave this page.} other {# files are waiting to be indexed. You can leave this page.}}
documents.renameDescription: This name appears in the list and in the citations under every answer. The PDF is not uploaded again.
documents.archiveDescription: “{title}” will be taken out of the assistant's reach, so students will no longer get answers drawn from it. The PDF is kept and you can restore it at any time — restoring re-indexes the document.
documents.noMatchesDescription: Try a different search term, or another status.
documents.uploadRefused: {count, plural, one {# file was not accepted} other {# files were not accepted}}

auth.signUpTitle: Create an account to keep your question history.
auth.intro: You do not need an account to ask questions. Signing in lets students revisit their conversations, and lets teachers manage admissions documents.
auth.roleStudentDescription: Ask questions and revisit your own history.
auth.roleTeacherDescription: Upload and manage admissions documents. Granted by an administrator.
auth.errorOauth: Google sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
auth.errorConfirm: That confirmation link is no longer valid. Please sign in again.
